# Overview

This script performs evolutionary analysis of the top differentially expressed gene (DEG) from the Maris Piper phosphate stress microarray dataset (E-MTAB-2990).

**Query gene:** PGSC0003DMT400069516  
**Gene description:** Multidrug/pheromone exporter, MDR family, ABC Transporter B (ABCB) family  
**Biological context:** This ABC transporter was the most significantly upregulated gene under low phosphate conditions in Maris Piper root tissue. ABC transporters in this family are known to transport auxin, which reshapes root architecture under nutrient stress — consistent with the phosphate starvation response observed in this dataset.

**Workflow:**

1. Load and inspect the BLAST tree (85 hits across 23 species)
2. Review all species before making selection decisions
3. Deliberately select 21 representative species with documented reasoning
4. Prune and plot the final phylogenetic tree

---

# Step 1: Load Tree and Review All Species

```{r evo_step1_load_and_review, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ape)

# Load the Newick tree downloaded from NCBI BLAST Tree View
# Query: PGSC0003DMT400069516 mRNA sequence BLASTed against Viridiplantae refseq_rna
tree_path <- "C:/Users/hrush/Desktop/UoS/project/Maris piper/results/tree.nwk"
tree <- read.tree(tree_path)

# Clean tip labels:
# - Remove surrounding quotes added by NCBI
# - Replace underscores with spaces
# - Strip "PREDICTED:" prefix
# - Keep only genus + species (first two words)
clean <- gsub("'", "", tree$tip.label)
clean <- gsub("_", " ", clean)
clean <- sapply(clean, function(x) {
  if (grepl("lcl\\|Query", x)) return("QUERY")
  x <- gsub("^PREDICTED: ", "", x)
  words <- strsplit(trimws(x), "\\s+")[[1]]
  paste(words[1], words[2])
})
tree$tip.label <- unname(clean)

# Review ALL species present in the BLAST tree before making any selection
# This step ensures species selection is deliberate, not arbitrary
species_counts <- as.data.frame(table(tree$tip.label))
colnames(species_counts) <- c("Species", "Copies_in_tree")
species_counts <- species_counts[order(-species_counts$Copies_in_tree), ]

cat("=== ALL SPECIES IN BLAST TREE (reviewed before selection) ===\n")
print(species_counts, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nTotal unique species:", nrow(species_counts), "\n")
cat("Total tips:", length(tree$tip.label), "\n")
```

---

# Step 2: Deliberate Species Selection

Based on the review above, 21 representative species were selected from the 23 unique species in the tree. The selection was made deliberately with the following documented reasoning:

**Redundancy reduction:**

- *S. melongena* appeared **31 times** → kept 1 representative (eggplant, distinct crop species)
- *S. lycopersicum* appeared **11 times** → kept 1 representative (tomato, key reference genome)
- *S. tuberosum* appeared **5 times** → kept 1 (same species as query gene)

**Excluded species (with reason):**

- *S. insanum* — too closely related to *S. incanum*, redundant for diversity
- *N. tomentosiformis* — adequately represented by other *Nicotiana* species

**Retained:**

- All singletons (species appearing only once)
- Both *Lycium* species for within-genus diversity
- Three *Nicotiana* species covering different ecological contexts
- Both outgroups (*Cornus florida*, *Helwingia omeiensis*) for tree rooting

```{r evo_step2_selection, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Selected species with documented rationale
selected_species <- c(
  "QUERY",                  # Focal gene — Maris Piper DEG under phosphate stress
  "Solanum tuberosum",      # Cultivated potato — same species as query gene
  "Solanum stenotomum",     # Diploid wild potato — close potato relative
  "Solanum pinnatisectum",  # Wild Mexican potato — distant potato relative
  "Solanum verrucosum",     # Warty potato — additional wild potato diversity
  "Solanum lycopersicum",   # Tomato — key Solanum crop, well-studied reference genome
  "Solanum cheesmaniae",    # Galapagos tomato — wild tomato relative
  "Solanum pennellii",      # Wild tomato — tomato clade diversity
  "Solanum melongena",      # Eggplant/Brinjal — major Solanum crop (non-potato/tomato)
  "Solanum dulcamara",      # Bittersweet nightshade — weedy Solanum lineage
  "Solanum nigrum",         # Black nightshade — herbaceous Solanum
  "Solanum incanum",        # Bitter apple — African Solanum diversity
  "Capsicum annuum",        # Bell pepper — sister genus to Solanum
  "Atropa belladonna",      # Deadly nightshade — distinct Solanaceae genus
  "Lycium barbarum",        # Goji berry — Lycium genus representative
  "Lycium ferocissimum",    # African boxthorn — second Lycium for genus diversity
  "Nicotiana tabacum",      # Common tobacco — major Nicotiana crop species
  "Nicotiana sylvestris",   # Woodland tobacco — Nicotiana diversity
  "Nicotiana attenuata",    # Coyote tobacco — stress-response studied Nicotiana
  "Cornus florida",         # Flowering dogwood — OUTGROUP (non-Solanaceae)
  "Helwingia omeiensis"     # Helwingia — OUTGROUP (non-Solanaceae, for rooting)
)

# Verify all selected species exist in the cleaned tree
missing <- selected_species[!selected_species %in% tree$tip.label]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  cat("WARNING — these species were NOT found in tree:\n")
  print(missing)
} else {
  cat("✅ All 21 selected species confirmed present in tree\n")
  cat("Proceeding to pruning and plotting...\n")
}
```

---

# Step 3: Prune Tree and Build Final Figure

```{r evo_step3_prune_and_plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Re-load and re-clean tree (ensures chunk is self-contained)
tree_path <- "C:/Users/hrush/Desktop/UoS/project/Maris piper/results/tree.nwk"
tree <- read.tree(tree_path)

clean <- gsub("'", "", tree$tip.label)
clean <- gsub("_", " ", clean)
clean <- sapply(clean, function(x) {
  if (grepl("lcl\\|Query", x)) return("QUERY")
  x <- gsub("^PREDICTED: ", "", x)
  words <- strsplit(trimws(x), "\\s+")[[1]]
  paste(words[1], words[2])
})
tree$tip.label <- unname(clean)

selected_species <- c(
  "QUERY", "Solanum tuberosum", "Solanum stenotomum",
  "Solanum pinnatisectum", "Solanum verrucosum", "Solanum lycopersicum",
  "Solanum cheesmaniae", "Solanum pennellii", "Solanum melongena",
  "Solanum dulcamara", "Solanum nigrum", "Solanum incanum",
  "Capsicum annuum", "Atropa belladonna", "Lycium barbarum",
  "Lycium ferocissimum", "Nicotiana tabacum", "Nicotiana sylvestris",
  "Nicotiana attenuata", "Cornus florida", "Helwingia omeiensis"
)

# Keep first occurrence of each selected species
# Drop by INDEX (not label name) to avoid duplicate-name confusion in drop.tip()
keep_idx <- c()
for (sp in selected_species) {
  idx <- which(tree$tip.label == sp)
  if (length(idx) > 0) keep_idx <- c(keep_idx, idx[1])
}
drop_idx <- seq_along(tree$tip.label)[!seq_along(tree$tip.label) %in% keep_idx]
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, drop_idx)
cat("Final tree tips:", length(tree_pruned$tip.label), "\n")

# Apply common name labels for readability
common_names <- c(
  "QUERY"                 = "★ Maris Piper — MDR/ABC Transporter (PGSC0003DMT400069516)",
  "Solanum tuberosum"     = "Potato",
  "Solanum stenotomum"    = "Diploid Potato",
  "Solanum pinnatisectum" = "Wild Mexican Potato",
  "Solanum verrucosum"    = "Warty Potato",
  "Solanum lycopersicum"  = "Tomato",
  "Solanum cheesmaniae"   = "Galapagos Tomato",
  "Solanum pennellii"     = "Wild Tomato",
  "Solanum melongena"     = "Eggplant / Brinjal",
  "Solanum dulcamara"     = "Bittersweet Nightshade",
  "Solanum nigrum"        = "Black Nightshade",
  "Solanum incanum"       = "Bitter Apple",
  "Capsicum annuum"       = "Bell Pepper",
  "Atropa belladonna"     = "Deadly Nightshade",
  "Lycium barbarum"       = "Goji Berry",
  "Lycium ferocissimum"   = "African Boxthorn",
  "Nicotiana tabacum"     = "Common Tobacco",
  "Nicotiana sylvestris"  = "Woodland Tobacco",
  "Nicotiana attenuata"   = "Coyote Tobacco",
  "Cornus florida"        = "Flowering Dogwood [OUTGROUP]",
  "Helwingia omeiensis"   = "Helwingia [OUTGROUP]"
)

tree_pruned$tip.label <- unname(sapply(tree_pruned$tip.label, function(x) {
  cn <- common_names[x]
  if (!is.na(cn)) paste0(x, "  (", cn, ")") else x
}))

# Colour by taxonomic group
get_colour <- function(label) {
  if (grepl("PGSC", label))            return("#e74c3c")  # red    — query gene
  if (grepl("Solanum", label))         return("#27ae60")  # green  — Solanum spp.
  if (grepl("Nicotiana", label))       return("#2980b9")  # blue   — Nicotiana spp.
  if (grepl("Capsicum|Atropa", label)) return("#e67e22")  # orange — Capsicum/Atropa
  if (grepl("Lycium", label))          return("#8e44ad")  # purple — Lycium spp.
  return("#7f8c8d")                                       # grey   — outgroup
}
tip_cols <- sapply(tree_pruned$tip.label, get_colour)

# Save high-resolution PNG
output_path <- "C:/Users/hrush/Desktop/UoS/project/Maris piper/results/phylogenetic_tree_final.png"
png(output_path, width = 2800, height = 1600, res = 150)
par(mar = c(4, 6, 6, 2))

plot.phylo(tree_pruned,
           type         = "phylogram",
           direction    = "rightwards",
           tip.color    = tip_cols,
           cex          = 0.82,
           font         = 3,
           edge.width   = 2.2,
           label.offset = 0.002)

title(
  main = "Phylogenetic Tree: ABC Transporter B Family (ABCB)\nMaris Piper Potato PGSC0003DMT400069516 vs Plant Orthologs\n21 representative species selected from 85 BLAST hits across 23 species",
  cex.main = 1.1,
  font.main = 2
)

legend("bottomright",
       legend  = c("Maris Piper query gene", "Solanum spp.", "Nicotiana spp.",
                   "Capsicum / Atropa", "Lycium spp.", "Outgroup"),
       fill    = c("#e74c3c", "#27ae60", "#2980b9", "#e67e22", "#8e44ad", "#7f8c8d"),
       border  = NA,
       cex     = 0.88,
       bty     = "o",
       box.col = "grey80",
       bg      = "white")

add.scale.bar(cex = 0.8, font = 2)
dev.off()
cat("✅ Tree saved to:", output_path, "\n")
```

```{r}
           tip.color    = tip_cols,

title(

  cex.main = 1.1,
  font.main = 2
)

legend("bottomright",
       legend  = c("Maris Piper query gene", "Solanum spp.", "Nicotiana spp.",
                   "Capsicum / Atropa", "Lycium spp.", "Outgroup"),
       fill    = c("#e74c3c", "#27ae60", "#2980b9", "#e67e22", "#8e44ad", "#7f8c8d"),
       border  = NA,
       cex     = 0.88,
       bty     = "o",
       box.col = "grey80",
       bg      = "white")

add.scale.bar(cex = 0.8, font = 2)
```

# Interpretation

The phylogenetic tree confirms that the Maris Piper ABCB transporter gene (PGSC0003DMT400069516) is **highly conserved across the Solanaceae family**, with closest orthologs in other *Solanum* species (97–99% sequence identity in BLAST hits).

Key observations:

- The query gene clusters tightly with other *Solanum tuberosum* sequences and wild potato relatives (*S. verrucosum*, *S. pinnatisectum*), confirming correct gene identity
- Conservation extends across the full Solanaceae family — tomato, eggplant, pepper, tobacco, goji berry — indicating this is an **ancient and functionally important gene**
- The two outgroups (*Cornus florida*, *Helwingia omeiensis*) root the tree outside Solanaceae, confirming the family-level clade is monophyletic
- The ABC transporter B family (ABCB) is well-characterised as an auxin efflux carrier — its upregulation under phosphate stress is consistent with **root architectural remodelling** to forage for phosphate

> *"The ABCB transporter upregulated in Maris Piper under phosphate stress is deeply conserved across the Solanaceae, suggesting an ancient role in coordinating hormonal responses to nutrient deficiency."*
